notes_for_editor: Thin record: two sources only, and neither gives a build date, builder, design, height, staffing, fires or current status. Cite 1 (Forest Lookouts index) gives the name McCAIN and the county Taylor. Its page carries one unlabelled photo (/uploads/1/5/9/1/1591048/8382948_orig.jpg), not added because no credit or licence is shown. Cite 2 (Mapcarta, built on OpenStreetMap) places the point at 29.70134, -83.35736, within about 20 m of the record's 29.7014, -83.35718, and tags it only as a generic tower (man_made=tower), so it does not confirm a lookout cab or a standing structure. Two WebSearch queries, the cached NHLR Florida list (31 entries, none McCain or Taylor), the cached FFLOS Florida index (no McCain) and the firelookout.org Florida page (no McCain entry) found nothing more. Florida Memory and anyplaceamerica returned 403 and were not read. The record's status and access stay unknown; no status_note or access fact was added. Before expanding, check Florida Forest Service records and Taylor County Historical Society holdings for a build date and the site's current state.
